rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Part II rows 13-18 print no row number, so row n takes the nth cell under the ATC/Tax Base/Tax Rate/Tax Withheld headers. Part II and III amounts follow the printed labels: the layout's txtTax24-30 match printed items 25-31 by label because this 2019 sheet adds 'Other Payments Made' at item 24. Peso comb + 2-slot cents pairs are money_joins. Radios and boxes take xbox_joins (box just left of the printed option).
